company.name: Belvo
company.shortDescription: Belvo is the open finance API platform that enables users to connect their accounts to an app.
company.description:
Belvo is the open finance API platform that enables users to connect their accounts to an app. The platform lets financial innovators to access and interpret data from their end-users in an easy and scalable way.

The company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Mexico City.

productsAndServices.description: An API-based infrastructure platform for connecting applications to financial accounts, accessing permissioned data, interpreting financial activity, and initiating account-to-account payments in Latin America.
productsAndServices.name: Belvo Open Finance API Platform

productsAndServices.description: APIs for accessing permissioned banking, employment, and fiscal information from connected financial institutions and public-sector sources.
productsAndServices.name: Financial Data Aggregation

productsAndServices.description: Data-processing services that categorize transactions and generate income, recurring-expense, employment, and risk insights from connected financial data.
productsAndServices.name: Financial Data Enrichment and Risk Insights

productsAndServices.description: Payment initiation services for accepting bank-to-bank payments, recurring collections, top-ups, and other account-based transfers through regional payment rails.
productsAndServices.name: Account-to-Account Payments

productsAndServices.description: Services for validating account ownership and matching banking details with customer identity information to reduce payment, onboarding, and fraud risks.
productsAndServices.name: Account Verification

productsAndServices.description: Self-service tools for integrating and managing Belvo, including account-connection interfaces, no-code launch options, analytics, and payment administration.
productsAndServices.name: Belvo Connect and Operations Tools
